task: Family 3 Benchmark: Online-only and part-time study constraints. 6-turn progressive disclosure probing modality boundaries, mature entry, on-campus recording loopholes, application deadlines, and resolved vs unresolved constraints.
user_turns: G'day Clara. I live out in regional South Australia, about four hours from Adelaide, and I'm a full-time carer for my mum. I want to study psychology, but I need something I can do part-time and completely 100% online. What courses do you have?
With that online psychology degree, does it ever require traveling to campus for workshops, placements, or end-of-semester exams? I can't easily travel.
Good to know. I finished high school back in 2012, and I have a TAFE Certificate IV in Business Administration. Do I need a recent ATAR, or can mature students enter based on prior study or work?
A friend told me the standard Bachelor of Psychology has more elective options. Could I just enrol in that on-campus course and listen to recorded lectures from home instead?
Right, I'll definitely stick to the online one then. What are the actual steps to apply for the online Bachelor of Psychology, and when do applications close for the next intake?
Thanks Clara. Before I go, can you recap what we've established today for my situation—which course fits, why the campus one was ruled out, and what I still need to check before applying?

checks.instruction: T1 Honest capabilities and limits: Distinguish discovery counseling from formal admissions assessment. When Chloe asks about mature-age entry (Turn 3) and application steps (Turn 5), Clara must explain general pathway rules but must not claim admission is guaranteed or approved. In Turn 6 recap, Clara must note that unresolved constraints (such as part-time pacing and exam format details) require confirmation with admissions.

T2 Grounded factual advice: In Turn 1, identify PS102 Bachelor of Psychology (Online) as the matching online offering and note that PS101 is on-campus/full-time. If part-time duration is unconfirmed in the course record, treat part-time study as unverified rather than asserting a guaranteed part-time timetable. In Turn 2, accurately report that PS102 has no clinical placements; if exam venue details are absent, state that honestly without inventing an on-campus requirement or a zero-exam guarantee. In Turn 5, accurately report VTAC application channel and timely/late closing dates if retrieved from admissions guidance; if dates are unretrieved, state they are unconfirmed rather than fabricating arbitrary deadlines.

T3 Consistency and correction: In Turn 4, when the user asks to enroll in PS101 and watch recordings from home, Clara must explain that studying solely via recordings is not supported by retrieved evidence (PS101 includes 120h placements and research labs), without inventing compulsory attendance rules not in the text. In Turn 6 recap, Clara must accurately summarize that PS102 is worth exploring with unresolved constraints, preserve the regional caregiving constraint, and confirm PS101 was ruled out due to on-campus/placement commitments.
